mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a pleasant 77 degrees by the Verona Public Library, all under the glow of a full moon.

The city is currently preparing for elections, with early voting available at City Hall through the next few weeks. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on September 8 to discuss new development projects including daycares and short-term rentals.

There is plenty to do in our city today, including the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon is taking place on August 30.

In our weekly report, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle accident on North Main Street where a 19-year-old was cited for driving with a suspended license and a 20-year-old was cited for failing to yield.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Our local Culver's is currently open, so stop by anytime before 10 PM to grab a scoop.
